sections.body: Your name, email address, and a hashed password when you sign up. The project answers, checklist progress, and mentor conversations you create while using AppPilot. We do not collect payment details (billing is not yet enabled), phone numbers, or any analytics trackers.

To run your account, save your progress, and provide the AI mentor. Mentor conversations are sent to our AI provider (Google Gemini, Anthropic, or OpenAI depending on configuration) so the mentor can reply — do not put passwords, API keys, or other secrets into chat messages.
Data is stored in MongoDB Atlas and the app runs on Render. Both are established hosting providers with their own security programs.
We use no tracking cookies, no analytics, no ad networks. A login token is stored in your browser's local storage purely to keep you signed in.
Every record is tied to your account and only readable by you. Other users cannot see your projects, answers, or mentor chats.
You can delete projects yourself. To delete your account and all associated data, contact us and we will remove it within 30 days.
Messages you send to the mentor are processed by a third-party AI provider under their API terms. We do not use your project content to train models.
Questions about your data: contact the site operator via the email shown on your account communications.
AppPilot is a teaching aid. It guides you through the process of building an app and mentors you on what to ask your own AI building tools. It does not write, host, or deploy your application's code.

The mentor's replies are AI-generated and may be wrong, incomplete, or outdated. They are educational guidance, not professional advice (legal, security, financial, or otherwise). You are responsible for decisions made about your own app.
Accounts receive a free credit allowance. Credits are consumed by AI mentor interactions. Credits have no cash value and are non-transferable.
No abusive use: don't attempt to access other users' data, flood the service, or use the mentor to generate harmful content. We may suspend accounts that abuse the service.

AppPilot is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not warrant that guidance, checklists, mentor replies, stage content, or generated documents are accurate, complete, current, or suitable for your situation. You use the service at your own risk and are solely responsible for verifying any guidance before acting on it — especially security, legal, and financial decisions.

To the maximum extent permitted by law, AppPilot and its operator are not liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages — including lost profits, lost data, security incidents, or business interruption — arising from use of the service or reliance on its content, even if advised of the possibility. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 12 months before the claim (or £50 if you paid nothing).

You are responsible for your own app: its code, its security, its legal compliance, and its users. AppPilot teaches a process — following it does not guarantee a secure, compliant, or successful product. Deployments, code, and infrastructure you create with other tools are entirely yours.
This is an early-stage product. We aim for reliability but offer no uptime guarantee. Keep your own copies of anything important (the build-log export exists for this).
We may update these terms; material changes will be noted on this page with a new date.

Passwords are salted and hashed (PBKDF2-SHA256, 100k iterations) — we never store plaintext passwords. All traffic is HTTPS via Render. Login sessions are server-side tokens that can be revoked (and are revoked automatically on password reset). Cross-user access is enforced at the API: every record carries a user_id and ownership is checked on every request — another user's project returns 404, not just hidden in the UI.

Signup, login, and AI endpoints are rate-limited. Password reset tokens are single-use, expire in one hour, and never reveal whether an email address has an account. AI usage is metered via a credit ledger — every grant and spend is a recorded transaction.
No API keys, database credentials, or secrets are stored in the codebase. All secrets live in environment variables on the hosting platform.
AppPilot uses a shared database with enforced per-user scoping — appropriate for low-sensitivity data like project checklists. Your data is never shared with other customers.

We have not yet undergone a formal security audit or certification (SOC 2, ISO 27001). Email delivery for password resets is optional and may not be enabled. This page describes real measures, not aspirations — if it's listed here, it's implemented and tested.

The security checklist and guided steps in AppPilot are educational. Completing them improves your app's security but cannot guarantee it — no checklist can. Security is an ongoing practice, and you remain responsible for your own app's safety and compliance.
Found a vulnerability? Please report it to the site operator privately before disclosing publicly — we'll acknowledge and fix promptly.
